summary: This clinical trial is testing the drug liraglutide combined with metformin compared to metformin alone in women who are obese, infertile, and have polycystic ovary syndrome, a hormone condition that can affect the ovaries. The study aims to look at live birth rates following frozen embryo transfer. It is currently in Phase 4 and plans to include 890 participants. Peking University Third Hospital is sponsoring the research.
